description: Archive one run into a Locker install and get its signed receipt. Omit installId to use this agent's own install, created on first use and named after this MCP client. Archive a whole task (workflow = the task name, inputs = the brief, outputs = what you delivered, labels = the ids of anything you created) or one consequential act; never every tool call. Never blocks on the allowance: past it the run is still kept and allowance.state says so; the plan page is a human act. run.id is the idempotency key (same id and same document: the first receipt, duplicate true; same id, different document: refused). Over 1 MB is refused before storage: resend with digests in place of bodies. The receipt proves FlurryPORT recorded this document at this chain position under this install; it does not prove this agent held a key. Check any receipt offline with verify_receipt.

installId.description: From list_locker_installs or create_locker_install; omit for this agent's own install.

id.description: Your own run or task id. It is the idempotency key: resending the same id with the same document returns the first receipt.

inputs.description: What went in: the brief, the arguments. Any JSON.

labels.description: At most 20 string pairs: captureIds, PR numbers, a client name.

outputs.description: What came out: what was delivered, the ids of anything created. Any JSON.

name.description: What the human would call this task or workflow.

name: archive_run
title: Archive run
